steps.question: The largest land animal, long trunk, eats leaves and fruits.

questionMeaning.hi: सबसे बड़ा ज़मीनी जानवर, लंबी सूँड, पत्ते और फल खाता है।
questionMeaning.hinglish: Sabse bada zameeni jaanwar, lambi soond, patte aur phal khaata hai.

steps.question: A wild animal with black and white stripes, eats leaves.

questionMeaning.hi: काली-सफ़ेद धारियों वाला जंगली जानवर, पत्ते खाता है।
questionMeaning.hinglish: Kaali-safed dhaariyon waala jangli jaanwar, patte khaata hai.

steps.question: A flightless bird, white and black, eats fish.

questionMeaning.hi: न उड़ने वाला सफ़ेद-काला पक्षी, मछली खाता है।
questionMeaning.hinglish: Na udne waala safed-kaala pakshi, machhli khaata hai.

steps.question: A tall animal with a long neck, eats leaves.

questionMeaning.hi: लंबी गर्दन वाला ऊँचा जानवर, पत्ते खाता है।
questionMeaning.hinglish: Lambi gardan waala ooncha jaanwar, patte khaata hai.

text.hi: अब किताब के पेज 54-55 पर ऊँट वाला पाठ पढ़ो। फिर सवालों के जवाब दो।
text.hinglish: Ab kitaab ke page 54-55 par oont waala paath padho. Phir sawaalon ke jawab do.
text.en: Now read the passage about the camel on pages 54–55 of your book. Then answer the questions.

steps.question: In what ways can the camel help us in agriculture?

questionMeaning.hi: ऊँट खेती में हमारी कैसे मदद करता है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Oont kheti mein hamari kaise madad karta hai?

options: It pulls ploughs, turns wheels to water fields and carries goods to the market.
steps.answer: It pulls ploughs, turns wheels to water fields and carries goods to the market.
steps.modelAnswer: Camels pull ploughs, turn wheels to irrigate fields and carry goods to the market.

modelMeaning.hi: ऊँट हल खींचते हैं, खेतों में पानी के लिए पहिए घुमाते हैं और सामान बाज़ार ले जाते हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Oont hal kheenchte hain, kheton mein paani ke liye pahiye ghumaate hain aur saamaan baazaar le jaate hain.

steps.question: What's the use of the camel's hump?

questionMeaning.hi: ऊँट के कूबड़ का क्या काम है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Oont ke koobad ka kya kaam hai?

options: It gives energy when food and water are scarce.
steps.answer: It gives energy when food and water are scarce.
steps.modelAnswer: The camel's hump is a source of energy when food and water are scarce.

modelMeaning.hi: जब खाना-पानी कम हो, तब ऊँट का कूबड़ उसे ताक़त देता है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Jab khaana-paani kam ho, tab oont ka koobad use taakat deta hai.

steps.question: How is the camel's body suited to the desert's hard conditions?

questionMeaning.hi: ऊँट का शरीर रेगिस्तान के लिए कैसे बना है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Oont ka shareer registaan ke liye kaise bana hai?

options: Broad soft feet, thick skin, three eyelids and special ears and nose.
steps.answer: Broad soft feet, thick skin, three eyelids and special ears and nose.
steps.modelAnswer: The camel has broad soft feet for the sand, a thick skin against heat and cold, three eyelids to keep out sand, and ears and nose that keep out sand storms.

modelMeaning.hi: ऊँट के चौड़े नरम पैर, मोटी खाल, तीन पलकें, और रेत रोकने वाले कान-नाक होते हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Oont ke chaude naram pair, moti khaal, teen palkein, aur ret rokne waale kaan-naak hote hain.

steps.question: What does the camel eat?
options: grass, dates and grain; dry leaves and seeds in the desert
steps.answer: grass, dates and grain; dry leaves and seeds in the desert
steps.modelAnswer: Camels eat grass, dates and grain. Deep in the desert they live on dry leaves and seeds.

modelMeaning.hi: ऊँट घास, खजूर और अनाज खाते हैं। रेगिस्तान में सूखे पत्ते और बीज खाकर रहते हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Oont ghaas, khajoor aur anaaj khaate hain. Registaan mein sookhe patte aur beej khaakar rehte hain.

steps.question: Give a suitable title to the passage.

questionMeaning.hi: इस पाठ का सही शीर्षक दो।
questionMeaning.hinglish: Is paath ka sahi sheershak do.
